segments.text:
V. 4.
If he ſin againſt thee ſeven times in a day, and ſeven times in a day return ſaying, I repent—That is, if he gives ſufficient Proof, that he does really repent, after having ſinned ever ſo often, receive him juſt as if he had never ſinned againſt thee. But this Forgiveneſs is due only to real Penitents. In a lower Senſe we are to forgive all, penitent or impenitent, (ſo as to bear them the ſincereſt Good-will, and to do them all the Good we can:) And that not ſeven Times only, but ſeventy Times ſeven.
